title: PPL Solid Phase Extraction for Dissolved Organic Matter Sample Preparation for LC-MS/MS
author: mthukral
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.b4x8qxrw
materials: Sample elution and preparation for LC-MS/MS analysis
The sample volume extracted needs to be known
Weigh vial with cap and methanol extract
Cap with acid washed teflon coated cap

steps.title: Assemble Tubing and Pipette
steps.instruction: Prepare the tubing assembly for sample loading.

substeps.instruction: Cut tubing to the desired length (recommended 30 inches/75 cm) with a precise, flat cut.
Push tubing firmly into a glass pipette until it reaches the bottom of the pipette tip.
Seal the top of the pipette with teflon tape and wrap a 5 cm piece of heat-shrink tubing over the junction.
Heat the shrink tubing with a heat gun until it fixes the tube-pipette connection.
Attach a luer adapter and stopcock to the other end of the tubing (heat tubing with a heat gun if necessary to fit the luer).

steps.title: Clean Materials
steps.instruction: Rinse all components to prevent contamination.

substeps.instruction: Rinse bottles, connectors, and tubing with MeOH followed by MilliQ water.
If DOC analysis from the same bottles is required (avoiding MeOH), soak adapters, reservoirs, and bottles in 3.7% HCl and rinse thoroughly with MilliQ water.

steps.title: Set Up SPE Station
steps.instruction: Configure the vacuum manifold and cartridge assembly.

substeps.instruction: Connect the SPE station to an HDPE vacuum carboy (solvent waste container) and a vacuum pump.
Remove lids on the vacuum station only for the ports being used.
Connect stopcock ends of tubing to an adapter inserted into a PPL cartridge at each port.
For samples <200 mL, install components vertically from base up: stopcock, PPL cartridge, adapter cap, and reservoir.
Add an extra port for an LC-MS H2O procedural blank for each use.

steps.title: Activate PPL Resin
steps.instruction: Wash the cartridges to activate the resin, ensuring they do not run dry between washes.

substeps.instruction: Wash with 3x column volume of 100% LC-MS grade MeOH.
Wash with 3x column volume of acidified H2O (prepared as 1 mL 37% HCl in 1 L LC-MS grade H2O; pH 2.0).
Wash with 3x column volume of 100% LC-MS grade MeOH.
Wash with 3x column volume of acidified H2O.

steps.title: Prepare and Load Samples
steps.instruction: Filter and acidify samples before loading onto the PPL cartridges.

substeps.instruction: Filter samples using combusted Glass Fiber Filters (GF/F, 0.7 µm). Use 47 mm filters for 0.5-2 L; use larger filters/cartridges for larger volumes. If using polysulfone cartridge filters, soak overnight in 0.01N HCl and rinse with MilliQ water until neutral pH. If using Supor or sterivex filters, discard the first >100 mL of filtrate.
Acidify samples with concentrated HCl to pH 2.0 (typically 0.12% acid for seawater).
For volumes <200 mL: Pour samples into the reservoir and let drip slowly (~1 drop/second or approx. 8 mL/min).
For volumes >200 mL: Place the pipette tip of the tubing assembly in the sample bottle and adjust vacuum to a loading flow rate between 8 and 16 mL/min.

steps.title: Wash and Dry Cartridges
steps.instruction: Remove salts and moisture from the resin.

substeps.instruction: Flush PPL cartridges with 2 column volumes of pH 2.0 H2O to remove salt.
Dry cartridges under nitrogen gas, shaking them to ensure all resin changes to a light yellow color.

steps.title: Store or Proceed to Elution
steps.instruction: Preserve the cartridges or move to the elution phase.

substeps.instruction: Wrap cartridges individually in aluminum foil and freeze at -80°C (or -20°C if -80°C is unavailable). For fieldwork, transport on dry ice before freezing.
If proceeding immediately, skip storage and move to elution.

steps.title: Elute DOM
steps.instruction: Extract the dissolved organic matter from the resin.

substeps.instruction: Set up PPL cartridges in an elution rack with an LC vial beneath each cartridge.
Elute each cartridge with 2 mL of LC-MS grade MeOH into the LC vial using a 1 mL pipette.
Cap the LC vial for short-term storage or proceed to dry down.

steps.title: Concentrate and Resuspend Extract
steps.instruction: Dry the extract and prepare it for LC-MS/MS analysis.

substeps.instruction: Dry the extract in a Centrivap (typically overnight) at room temperature.
Store dried extract at -80°C or -20°C, or resuspend for analysis.
Resuspend the DOM pellet in 100 µL of 80% LC-MS grade MeOH + 0.1% FA by pipetting the solvent up and down.
Transfer the sample to a micro glass insert inside a 1.5 mL HPLC vial. Centrifuge if the sample does not dissolve completely to pellet debris.

steps.title: Determine Carbon Extraction Efficiency (Optional)
steps.instruction: Measure the efficiency of the extraction process using flow-through or dried aliquot methods.

substeps.instruction: Collect flow-through sample from the SPE column into a combusted DOC vial.
Weigh combusted GC vials with teflon lined caps.
Evaporate extracts in DOC vials in a speedvac (RT) or oven (40°C) overnight, covering loosely with combusted aluminum foil.
Transfer 100 µL (or more) of methanol extract into a combusted DOC vial (Thermo Scientific VOA vials) using a Hamilton-syringe (cleaned 10x with methanol and wiped with Kimwipe).
Calculate weight difference (full - empty) and convert mass to volume using methanol density at lab temperature.
Elute SPE-DOM into a GC vial and cap immediately.
After drying, add at least 10 mL of Milli-Q water using a clean bulb pipette.
Place sample in an ultrasonic bath for 10 min; agitate or pipette if not dissolved.
Acidify DOC sample to pH 2 (~1 mL conc. HCl per liter).
Measure DOC concentration using a TOC analyzer.
Calculate extraction efficiency as the ratio between SPE-DOC and bulk DOC, or by subtracting permeate DOC from pre-filtered seawater DOC.
